rationale: readRetainedDependency learns one exact-endpoint branch for the kinematics spec. It applies only when a reference names the exact pre-repair bytes that the 37 classical-closure observed-behavior proofs record as an artifact and as their run's test. Every other branch, historical hash list, release binding, residual binding, review reader and mutation rule is byte-identical; the revision is one import plus one call site.
